title: Standardized biased sign
statement: For $p\in\mathbb{R}$ and a sign $x\in\{-1,+1\}$, define its standardized value to be $(x-(1-2p))/\sigma(p)$, where $\sigma(p)$ is the bias standard deviation.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define signValue or biasSigma; the prose interprets them as the real sign value and bias standard deviation.
